articles.title: Juan Vivas: "No confío en Pedro Sánchez para defender Ceuta y no confío en Pedro Sánchez para defender España"
articles.summary: 'El Hormiguero' ha comenzado este lunes la semana con la visita del presidente de la Ciudad Autónoma de Ceuta, Juan Vivas, con quien Pablo Motos ha abordado la delicada situación que atraviesa la ciudad a raíz de la llegada masiva de migrantes ocurrida a finales de julio.
articles.body: 'El Hormiguero' ha comenzado este lunes la semana con la visita del presidente de la Ciudad Autónoma de Ceuta, Juan Vivas, con quien Pablo Motos ha abordado la delicada situación que atraviesa la ciudad a raíz de la llegada masiva de migrantes ocurrida a finales de julio. PABLO MOTOS. Presidente, vaya recibimiento, está claro que la gente está con usted JUAN VIVAS. Lo verdaderamente importante es que la gente está con Ceuta, y estar con Ceuta es estar con España. Yo soy un mero instrumento. Quisiera dar las gracias a El Hormiguero por haberle dado voz a Ceuta en el momento más crítico de su historia y gracias al pueblo de Ceuta por no rendirse y gracias a toda España por el apoyo y la solidaridad. Ceuta no se vende, Ceuta se defiende y Ceuta es España hasta la médula. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Por qué la frontera de Ceuta no estaba preparada? JUAN VIVAS. Yo creo que hay tres factores, una indolencia manifiesta, una irresponsabilidad y un intento de no molestar a Marruecos. Creo que es la mezcla de estas tres cosas. El gobierno de la nación no ha estado a la altura, no ha hecho caso de las alertas y de los avisos, no se ha atendido al CNI. Nadie entiende por qué no se tomaron las medidas necesarias y por qué se ha tardado un mes en tomar decisiones. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Cree que se podía haber evitado? JUAN VIVAS. Yo entiendo que si se hubieran puesto todas las capacidades del Estado, se podría haber evitado. Lo que está en juego es nuestra democracia y nuestra integridad nacional. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Es cierto que desde el gobierno les dijeron que no les llamaran más para avisar de la posible invasión, que dejaran de ser pesados? JUAN VIVAS. Sí. Yo hablé con el jefe de gabinete del presidente, y me dijo que todo estaba bajo control, que estuviéramos tranquilos, que era lo de todos los veranos. Como no estábamos tranquilos, seguimos llamando y ya nos dijo, que dejáramos de insistir. Nosotros no sabíamos concretamente que se iba a producir la invasión, pero sí teníamos conocimiento de que había un calentamiento, que algo estaba ocurriendo, pero no nos escucharon. PABLO MOTOS. ¿En qué momento se dio cuenta de que estaba solo? JUAN VIVAS. Desde el momento en el que no fueron atendidas nuestras llamadas, lo supe. PABLO MOTOS. Marruecos afirma que Ceuta y Melilla son parte de su territorio, ¿qué opina al respecto? JUAN VIVAS. Marruecos no reconoce nuestra soberanía y ha procurado desde siempre la asfixia de Ceuta y Melilla. Ya he dicho antes que lo que dice Marruecos acerca de la soberanía no es nada nuevo. Son planteamientos absolutamente infundados. Lo único que nos importa es lo que pueda hacer nuestro gobierno al respecto. Nosotros somos los primeros interesados en que haya un buen entendimiento con Marruecos, pero ha de ser desde el respeto y desde la integridad. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Cree que Marruecos posee información comprometida de Pedro Sánchez y por eso está tragando con todo? JUAN VIVAS. Yo no tengo información al respecto, por lo que no puedo opinar. Lo que sí veo es una extraordinaria sumisión del gobierno de España hacia Marruecos que me resulta absolutamente incomprensible. No hay quien lo entienda. ¿Cómo es posible que estemos organizando, por ejemplo, un mundial de fútbol con un país que acaba de cometer una invasión contra nosotros? Marruecos no es un país fiable, y a la vista está. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Cómo cree que se puede volver a la normalidad? JUAN VIVAS. Ceuta está en una situación de alto riesgo desde todos los puntos de vista. Es una olla a presión que en cualquier momento puede estallar. Estamos en una situación límite. La única solución es que retornen absolutamente todos los migrantes que entraron en Ceuta, sin excepción. PABLO MOTOS. ¿Confía en Pedro Sánchez para defender Ceuta? JUAN VIVAS. Los antecedentes inhabilitan la posibilidad de que yo confíe en Pedro Sánchez para defender Ceuta y los antecedentes inhabilitan la posibilidad de que yo confíe en Pedro Sánchez para defender España.

articles.title: Goo Goo Dolls' John Rzeznik draws line on politics at concerts: 'I'm not going to lecture you'
articles.summary: John Rzeznik told Rick Beato he won't lecture Goo Goo Dolls fans about politics, saying concertgoers deserve to leave feeling better than they arrived.
articles.body: Goo Goo Dolls frontman John Rzeznik said Wednesday during an "Everything Music" interview with producer Rick Beato that he refuses to lecture concertgoers about politics because fans from across the ideological spectrum come together for the same reason: to see a show. While discussing why he believes live music remains important during divided times, Rzeznik said political and religious differences are not what matters when he takes the stage. "I got people, fans, friends from every walk of life, every political stripe, everything," he said. "And I always stress, we got one thing in common because we're living in weird times. We got one thing in common, and that's we're all here to see a show, and I'm not going to lecture people about anything." DOLLY PARTON REFUSED TO PICK POLITICAL SIDES FOR DECADES: ‘I’M NOT IN POLITICS, I’M AN ENTERTAINER’ Entertainment commentator Christian Toto told Fox News Digital that artists can pay a price with their audiences when performances turn into political forums, particularly when celebrity political commentary is already widespread. "Artists do risk alienating fans when they get on a soap box. That's always been true, but it's even more so today. Why? We're inundated with political screeds, particularly from the rich and famous. In many cases, the arguments being shared are one-dimensional and poorly thought out," Toto said. "Plus, they're rarely spoken to change hearts or minds," he continued. "The commentary is typically angry and filled with partisan talking points. What does ‘Free Palestine’ mean to someone who questions that community's embrace of violence?" JOHN RICH CLAIMS JELLY ROLL KNEW HE’D LOSE HALF HIS FANS OVER POLITICAL COMMENTS Toto pointed to the cost of attending major concerts as another reason artists could frustrate audiences by devoting stage time to politics. "Concert tickets are insanely high in 2026," he said. "Imagine forking over so much money and then, mid-concert, you get a political lecture. Who wants that? Kudos to Rzeznik for understanding that simple truth, one that eludes many ego-driven rockers." Rzeznik’s approach mirrors comments Rolling Stones frontman Mick Jagger made earlier this year. Fox News Digital reported in July that Jagger viewed his job during concerts as helping audiences forget their problems for a few hours rather than preaching to them. GOO GOO DOLLS SINGER HOSPITALIZED WITH PNEUMONIA; BAND CANCELS CONCERTS IN SOUTH AFRICA Explaining his approach to performing, Jagger made clear he did not believe audiences came to see him for political instruction. "I don't want to lecture them," Jagger said. Other rock stars have faced a different reception after bringing politics into performances. In June, Bruce Springsteen and The Black Crowes frontman Chris Robinson faced backlash from some concertgoers following political remarks onstage. Rzeznik told Beato he wants Goo Goo Dolls fans to instead leave a concert feeling better than when they arrived. articles.title: Arizona mom used her flip-flop to fight off a coyote attacking her 4-year-old daughter
articles.summary: Brittany Cardinal was fighting off a coyote attack with a flip-flop when the animal bit her face while she shielded her 4-year-old daughter.
articles.body: An Arizona mom out in her neighborhood flying a kite with her 4-year-old daughter a couple of Sundays ago found herself in a fight with a coyote that refused to back down. The coyote had started nipping at the little girl, according to mom Brittany Cardinal, and before she knew it, mom was swinging her flip-flop at it. "We had gone outside because it was windy. And my daughter’s like, 'oh, let's fly a kite,'" Cardinal said, reports AZ Family. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS A normal activity on a windy Sunday afternoon. That was until mom heard her daughter scream and saw the coyote going after the girl. "I picked her up and then I started yelling at it, thinking, of course, it’s going to go away, and then it didn't," Cardinal said. "So then I took off my flip-flop, and I was trying to scare it with that by like trying to hit it." As the mom tried to fight off the coyote and get it to leave them alone, she fell. The coyote then bit her on the face. articles.title: 2026 Emmys best, boldest and most 'wait, what' red carpet looks: From Zendaya's crystals to Shailene Woodley's closet roulette
articles.summary: The Emmys red carpet delivered method dressing, unapologetic color, coordinated families and an expectant plus-one.
articles.body:
The 2026 Emmy Awards are celebrating the best performances on television, but some of the night's most memorable moments took place before anyone stepped onstage.

As the first major awards show of the season, the Emmys carpet might also have offered an early look at the fashion moments that may carry over to the red carpets ahead. This year delivered method dressing, unapologetic splashes of color, coordinated families and an expectant plus-one. If this was the dress rehearsal, we're in for a fun season.

Here are the best and boldest looks of the night — and the completely unofficial awards we're giving them.

Tom Pelphrey may have been Kaley Cuoco's official date, but he wasn't her only plus-one. The actor's pale pink gown gave their second daughter her first major red carpet moment.

Derek Hough didn't merely wear teal. He devoted himself to it with a monochromatic look that even included his shoes. The green hue is the winner for him tonight.

Hottest couple: Keri Russell and Matthew Rhys

Keri Russell and Matthew Rhys didn't need coordinated black looks to convince me they're the hottest couple on the carpet, but they certainly didn't hurt. Her black leather Khatie gown and his Thom Browne tuxedo were perfectly matched without veering into prom-photo territory.

There are few guarantees during awards season, but Zendaya landing on the best-dressed list is one of them. The two-time Emmy winner returned to the show as a nominee for Euphoria, wearing a crystal-covered Prada gown and a dramatic new pixie cut. Did we expect anything less?

At 6 years old, Duke McCloud already knows how to give the internet what it wants. The All Her Fault star (and former Yahoo Kids Rate contributor ) flashed the viral 6-7 hand gesture on the carpet, securing his place as the night's cutest meme correspondent.

Most likely to go home with herself: Meg Stalter

Hacks star Meg Stalter didn't just dress like an Emmy — she became the Emmy, complete with gold body paint, wings and an atom. She didn't win in her category, but, really, does it matter?

Most mirrors in the building: Selena Gomez

Selena Gomez is recognized as an executive producer for Only Murders in the Building . Yet, the only mystery here is how she managed not to blind the entire red carpet with her gold Louis Vuitton gown covered in tiny mirrors.

Best case for color theory: Colman Domingo

Colman Domingo paired a terracotta jacket with a bright pink shirt, miniature bow tie, magenta sash, ivory pants and white boots — a list that shouldn't necessarily add up to a look this good. But on one of Hollywood's most reliable dressers, it makes perfect sense.

Best sister act: Dakota and Elle Fanning

Dakota and Elle Fanning share genes, but apparently not a red carpet mood board. The two went in different directions with their looks — Dakota in black and white, and Elle in a shimmering mint gown with trailing fringe. Both were undeniably stylish.

Most likely to slay: Sarah Michelle Gellar

Sarah Michelle Gellar has spent decades slaying, so why stop on Emmys night? The Buffy the Vampire Slayer star refused to be missed in a hot-pink satin column dress, paired with enough diamonds to give the color some competition.

It's practically magic that Nicole Kidman appeared at the Emmys at all. The Margo's Got Money Troubles actor and producer returned after nine years away from the award show, and on the heels of the long-awaited release of Practical Magic 2 . Her white Chanel gown, decorated with floral details along the neckline and grounded by black pumps, made the comeback well worth the wait.

Luckiest spin of closet roulette: Shailene Woodley

Shailene Woodley appears to have played closet roulette. The newly minted Emmy winner combined a periwinkle halter top, gold sequined pants, burgundy gloves and a colorful necklace all in one look.

Strongest supporting cast: Mariska Hargitay and family

Emmys host Mariska Hargitay showed up to the red carpet with her strongest support cast: husband Peter Hermann and their three children, Andrew, Amaya and August. The family was almost suspiciously coordinated, with the women in red sequins and the men in black-tie tuxedos. Clearly, everyone read the family group chat (but don't expect them to keep up with the host's numerous outfit changes).

articles.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' box office collection Day 12 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi, Ravi Kishan film crosses Rs 192 crore domestic net milestone amid slower second-week growth
articles.summary: 'Mirzapur The Movie' has moved past the Rs. 190 crore mark in India as it heads into Day 12, with its worldwide gross now nearing the Rs. 275 crore mi.
articles.body: 'Mirzapur The Movie' has moved past the Rs. 190 crore mark in India as it heads into Day 12, with its worldwide gross now nearing the Rs. 275 crore milestone. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer, however, has seen its daily numbers taper off noticeably as it moves deeper into its second week, a natural progression for most theatrical releases at this stage of their run. Attention now turns to whether the film can hold on long enough to breach the coveted Rs. 200 crore India net club. With weekday collections continuing to slow down, the coming days will be crucial in determining just how much further the crime drama can stretch its overall tally.'Mirzapur The Movie' Day 1 to Day 11 earningsThe film opened with Rs. 25.75 crore net in India on Day 1 before witnessing a rise on Day 2, when it earned Rs. 32 crore. Its strongest single-day performance came on Day 3, with collections reaching Rs. 36 crore. The film subsequently registered Rs. 16 crore on Day 4, Rs. 15.60 crore on Day 5, Rs. 12.55 crore on Day 6 and Rs. 10.55 crore on Day 7. This took its first-week India net total to Rs. 148.45 crore.During the second week, the film added Rs. 9.50 crore on Day 8, followed by Rs. 13.50 crore on Day 9 and Rs. 13.25 crore on Day 10. Its cumulative India net stood at Rs. 184.70 crore by the end of Day 10, while the domestic gross reached Rs. 220.04 crore. On Day 11, the film earned Rs. 5.50 crore net across 7,014 shows, taking its India net total to Rs. 190.20 crore and India gross to Rs. 226.64 crore.‘Mirzapur The Movie’ overseas collection and worldwide totalThe film has also generated earnings from international markets. It collected Rs. 4.25 crore overseas on Day 1, Rs. 6 crore on Day 2 and Rs. 7 crore on Day 3. Its overseas gross then stood at Rs. 2.50 crore on Day 4, Rs. 3.50 crore on Day 5, Rs. 2 crore on Day 6 and Rs. 2.50 crore on Day 7. The first-week overseas total consequently reached Rs. 35.50 crore.The film added Rs. 2.50 crore from overseas markets on Day 8 and Rs. 4 crore each on Day 9 and Day 10, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs. 46 crore by the end of Day 10. With its India gross standing at Rs. 220.04 crore at that stage, the worldwide gross was approximately Rs. 266.04 crore. On Day 11, the film earned another Rs. 1 crore overseas, pushing its international total to Rs. 47 crore and worldwide gross to Rs. 273.64 crore.'Mirzapur The Movie' Day 12 collection live trackingAs per Sacnilk, 'Mirzapur The Movie' is currently running across 4,661 shows on Day 12, with a live collection of Rs. 2.19 crore added so far in the day.This takes the film's overall India gross to Rs. 229.22 crore and its India net to Rs. 192.39 crore, with the final Day 12 figure expected to be updated once all shows have concluded.Day wise collections for 'Mirzapur The Movie'Week 1: Rs. 148.45 croreDay 8: Rs. 9.50 croreDay 9: Rs. 13.50 croreDay 10: Rs. Rs. 13.25 croreDay 11: Rs. 5.50 croreDay 12 [LIVE]: Rs. 2.19 croreTOTAL: Rs. 192.39 croreMore about 'Mirzapur The Movie'Directed by Gurmmeet Singh, written by Puneet Krishna, 'Mirzapur The Movie' has been produced by Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar under Excel Entertainment. The film expands the popular crime franchise from streaming to theatres and is set between the sixth and seventh episodes of the first season of the original series. Notably, the film brings back fan-favourite characters who did not survive the later seasons, including Divyenndu's Munna Tripathi and Shweta Tripathi Sharma's Golu Gupta. The ensemble cast features Pankaj Tripathi reprising his role as Akhandanand "Kaleen" Tripathi, alongside Ali Fazal as Guddu Pandit and Divyenndu as Munna Tripathi, with Rasika Dugal, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Jitendra Kumar, Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Sonal Chauhan, Mohit Malik and Sushant Singh. The Central Board of Film Certification cleared the film with an ‘A’ certificate after approximately 35 seconds of cuts involving language and intimate scenes.
